answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. KL 0.032 and TV 0.043 are the lowest of any non-base category. They sit just below the quantized ranges (0.039-0.071 and 0.048-0.055) and well below fine-tuned (KL 0.081+) and system-prompted (KL 0.197+). Top-1 agreement 0.943 is near the quantized range (0.945-0.955) and above the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908). Token-DiFR gap 0.044 is close to the quantized 0.03-0.04, while fine-tuned is 0.10+. Raw-score shift÷TV of 2.6 is near the quantized 2.2-2.3 and outside the system-prompted range (3.3-3.9). Sequence agreement 0.625 is a bit low for quantized (0.67-0.70) but within single-draw noise. Every value is non-zero, so base is ruled out. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, since 0.943 falls in its top-1 range, but its KL and DiFR are too high.
